Regulation: B.C. Reg. 122/2026
Made under: Renewable Energy Projects (Streamlined Permitting) Act
Published in: No. 13 – B.C. Regs. 110 to 124, July 14, 2026
Deposit date: July 10, 2026

B.C. Reg. 122/2026, deposited July 10, 2026, under theRENEWABLE ENERGY PROJECTS(STREAMLINED PERMITTING) ACT[section 20]. Order in Council 299/2026, approved and ordered July 10, 2026. On the recommendation of the undersigned, the Lieutenant Governor, by and with the advice and consent of the Executive Council, orders that the Renewable Energy Projects (Streamlined Permitting) Regulation, B.C. Reg. 93/2025, is amended as set out in the attached Schedule. — A. DIX,Minister of Energy and Climate Solutions; J. WICKENS,Presiding Member of the Executive Council. 1	Section 1 of the Renewable Energy Projects (Streamlined Permitting) Regulation, B.C. Reg. 93/2025, is amended by adding the following definition: "Nass Valley Transmission Line project"means the project to construct and operate an electric transmission line, and related facilities, from around the proposed Ksi Lisims LNG facility to around the electric transmission line to be constructed in the North of Terrace Transmission Line project;. 2	Section 2 is amended by adding the following paragraph: (e)	the Nass Valley Transmission Line project. 3	Section 3 is amended by adding the following paragraph: (e)	the Nass Valley Transmission Line project. 4	Section 4 (2) is repealed and the following substituted: (2)	The following projects are prescribed for the purposes of section 14 (d) of the Act: (a)	the North of Terrace Transmission Line project; (b)	the Nass Valley Transmission Line project. minutes_briefs.title: Nass Valley Transmission Line added to BC streamlined permitting program
minutes_briefs.summary: British Columbia has added the Nass Valley Transmission Line project to its streamlined permitting program. This means the project, which will build an electric transmission line from the proposed Ksi Lisims LNG facility to the North of Terrace Transmission Line, can now use faster, simpler approval processes. The change also makes the project eligible for certain exemptions under the Renewable Energy Projects (Streamlined Permitting) Act.
minutes_briefs.action_required: No action needed for most businesses; this change affects the specific transmission line project.
